purpose: Teach: 美学/うかがい/異物/恥ずかしながら/相まって/のけ/汚し/勝た

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、商売に美学を持っていらしたぞ
lines.en: Your father had a real aesthetic about business.
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence. Weight on each phrase. Gaze into distance, remembering. Patient silence between thoughts. The voice of a man who has earned his reflections.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお得意様のお声をうかがい、即対応された
lines.en: Yes. He listened closely to our best clients and responded immediately.
lines.style: Respectful, formal register. Each word placed with care. Slight forward lean in posture—earnest attention to the elder's words. Steady, unrushed delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、お客様への異物混入の責任を、自ら取られた
lines.en: When a product defect reached a customer, he took personal responsibility for it.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Pause before 'took'—weight of the memory. Low tone, not mourning but acknowledging something significant. Slight trailing-off, like the weight of that responsibility still lingers.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 恥ずかしながら、私はその覚悟まで至っておりません
lines.en: I'm ashamed to say I haven't yet developed that level of resolve.
lines.style: Honest, unguarded admission. Slight drop in volume on 'ashamed.' Not self-pitying—clear-eyed about his own shortcoming. Steady breath underneath, grounded in respect rather than apology.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの実直と運が相まっての成功だぞ
lines.en: Your father's integrity and fortune worked together to build what he created.
lines.style: Reflective, philosophical tone. Slow pace. Gentle emphasis on 'integrity'—the word carries importance. Eyes half-closed, speaking from deep memory. Not sad, but holding something precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員をのけ者にしないリーダーでした
lines.en: Yes. He was a leader who never turned his back on his staff.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Clear emphasis on 'never'—a principle, not a coincidence. Straight posture. Voice carries both admiration and personal commitment to the same standard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、会社の名を汚した者を厳しく咎められた
lines.en: He held those who brought dishonor to the company strictly accountable.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Steady, unflinching delivery. The words 'strictly accountable' land with quiet authority. Not cruel—just clear about consequence. Unwavering eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが勝たれた市場、私が守ります
lines.en: Yes. The market he won, I will protect.
lines.style: Final and resolute. Slight pause before 'I will protect'—a vow, not a casual promise. Voice lowers into deeper register. Breath steady, full-bodied. The closing statement of a man accepting his inheritance.
